name: Maximum-Class Unlabeled Compression and the Corner Boundary
statement: Every maximum class of VC dimension $d$ has a representation map and an unlabeled compression scheme of size $d$. On an ample class, representation maps are exactly the out-maps of unique-sink orientations and each yields an unlabeled scheme of size equal to the VC dimension. An ample class has a corner peeling exactly when it has an acyclic such orientation. Hall's 299-concept maximum class in dimension twelve has VC dimension three but no corner, showing that optimal unlabeled compression need not come from a corner peeling.
